spans.s: ज (I) a. (f. जा) (at the end of compounds) Born from or in, produced or caused by, growing in &c. R.i.31, M.i.43, 44, 45, 46.
ज (II) m. 1. A father; 2. production, birth; 3. poison; 4. an imp; 5. a conqueror.
